questions.subject: HUMAN_GEOGRAPHY
questions.topic: Rainfall on the two sides of a ridge
questions.learningObjective: Identify rainfall on the two sides of a ridge.

stimulus.body: Source note: Rainfall on the two sides of a ridge. Moist air rises on the windward side, cools, and drops rain, while the leeward side receives little rain in the shadow.

questions.stem: With reference to the source note, explain rainfall on the two sides of a ridge.

answer.exemplar: Moist air rises on the windward side, cools, and drops rain, while the leeward side receives little rain in the shadow.

questions.explanation: Orographic lifting concentrates rain on the windward side. The tempting idea that both sides are equal fails because moisture is removed before air descends.
questions.hint: Think about air rising and cooling.

questions.subject: HUMAN_GEOGRAPHY
questions.topic: Proportion of rainfall lost on the lee side
questions.learningObjective: Identify the proportion of rainfall lost on the lee side.
questions.stem: Turning to proportion of rainfall lost on the lee side, 800 mm windward and 200 mm lee; what proportion is lost?
questions.explanation: Six hundred of eight hundred millimetres is lost, a seventy-five percent loss. The tempting idea of using the lee amount as the loss fails because loss is the difference.
questions.hint: Subtract lee rainfall from windward rainfall.
